purpose: CB18 pre-census inputs (CREATIVE_BATCH_18.md L4, sections 3, 5): the q0500 captures and sweeps and the q0501 samples (= seals/lt3_census_inputs_C2.json). Written before any CB18 census ran; counts-only use.
